name: billingengine
description: Create invoices and customers and record payments in BillingEngine from any MCP client.
long_description: Connects Claude and other MCP clients to your BillingEngine account. Create customers and draft invoices, look up open invoices, save invoice PDFs and e-invoices and record payments. Invoices are created as drafts and nothing can be deleted. Needs a paid BillingEngine plan and the API key from Settings > API.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your BillingEngine API key from Settings > API (paid plans only).

tools.name: find_customers
tools.description: Searches customers by company, name or email

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Creates a draft invoice for a customer

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists invoices, filtered by status, customer, number or date

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Returns one invoice with items and payment status

tools.name: download_invoice
tools.description: Saves the PDF or the XML e-invoice of an invoice on this computer

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Records a payment for sent invoices

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Lists payments, optionally for one invoice
